description: RODP Départemental (Réseau de Transport NaTran) is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce jeu de données présente, pour les départements, les informations relatives aux redevances d’occupation du domaine public (RODP) dues par NaTran pour le passage de ses canalisations de gaz sur le domaine public. Coverage: France. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Infrastructures, Territoires et régions. The portal shows 2025-10-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
